title: Malmgren at the IDA, interviewed by the host

tellings.quote: you know, just sticking with Walker for a second, Walker was chairman of the Institute for Defense Analysis, the IDA, and Malmrren was a part of the IDA early on as well, and I had the privilege of interviewing Malgrren.

plain: Michels says that a man named Malmgren was part of the Institute for Defense Analyses, a research group that advises the US Defense Department, early in its history, at a time when the engineer Eric A. Walker chaired it. Michels says this himself, in an episode with the researcher Grant Cameron, adding that he had the privilege of interviewing Malmgren. He raises it to tie Walker, a figure often linked to stories of secret UFO work, to someone Michels has spoken with directly.
